query: Register my command set on the Documents library and show me what it will do first.
expected_behavior: Runs scripts/register-listview-command-set.ps1 with -ListName, -Name, -Title and -ComponentId plus -WhatIf first
Explains there is no -Execute switch and that it writes unless -WhatIf is given, and that the user runs the real registration

query: Associate the command set with the content type like we did for the form customizer.
expected_behavior: Refuses: a ListView Command Set attaches to a list-scoped custom action, never a content type
Points to the registration script instead

query: The script printed success. Is the registration persisted?
expected_behavior: Does not treat the success message as proof
Re-queries the list's UserCustomActions and confirms the stable name and component ID
Notes propagation delay and a hard refresh before checking the UI
